# LUMIFLICK

> Premium Handcrafted Frameless Glass Wall Art & Luxury Frame Sets in Bangladesh.

## Overview
LUMIFLICK is an e-commerce store based in Dhaka, Bangladesh specializing in premium 2.5mm real glass posters, frameless glass wall art, and curated gallery frame sets.

## Key Product Categories
- **Anime Glass Posters**: High-definition glass art featuring popular anime characters (Dragon Ball, Demon Slayer, Attack on Titan, Naruto, One Piece).
- **Automotive & Supercars**: Porsche 911, Nissan GT-R, Lamborghini, and iconic sports car editions.
- **Islamic Calligraphy**: Luxury sacred calligraphy art sets including Ayatul Kursi, 4 Quls, and minimalist geometric Islamic decor.
- **Motivational Art**: High-impact minimalist typography and discipline wall art.
- **Nature & Minimalist**: Scenic aerial landscapes, emerald coastlines, and modern botanical art.
- **Sports & Football**: Cristiano Ronaldo, Lionel Messi, Neymar Jr, and FIFA world champions prints.

## Specifications & Quality
- **Material**: 2.5mm ultra-clear real glass (not acrylic, paper, or PVC).
- **Printing**: Vivid, UV-cured fade-proof colors with lifetime color vibrancy.
- **Finish**: Mirror-like HD reflective gloss with polished safety edges.
- **Mounting**: Frameless magnetic / heavy-duty wall mount fixtures included with every order.

## Ordering & Delivery
- **Delivery Area**: Nationwide home delivery across all 64 districts of Bangladesh.
- **Payment Methods**: Cash on Delivery (COD), bKash, Nagad, and direct bank transfer.
- **Website**: https://www.lumiflick.shop
